title: For the top 10 (port status, device owner) combinations with the most ports
question: For the top 10 (port status, device owner) combinations with the most ports that are admin_state_up = 1, bound to a security group, and whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports', show the port status, device owner, count of such bound admin-up ports, the total number of ports for that status/owner with resource type 'ports', the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp, the total security-group bindings and DNS records across those bound admin-up ports, along with the average bound admin-up port count across these top-10 combinations. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH port_level AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.status,
    p.device_owner,
    sa.updated_at,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securitygroupportbindings sg WHERE sg.port_id = p.id) AS sg_binding_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portdnses pd WHERE pd.port_id = p.id) AS dns_record_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND sa.resource_type = 'ports'
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    device_owner,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sg_binding_count > 0 THEN port_id END) AS bound_admin_up_count,
    COUNT(port_id) AS total_ports,
    MIN(updated_at) AS earliest_updated,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sg_binding_count > 0 THEN sg_binding_count ELSE 0 END) AS total_sg_bindings,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sg_binding_count > 0 THEN dns_record_count ELSE 0 END) AS total_dns_records
  FROM port_level
  GROUP BY status, device_owner
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM grouped
  ORDER BY bound_admin_up_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(bound_admin_up_count) AS avg_bound_count
  FROM top10
)
SELECT
  t.status,
  t.device_owner,
  t.bound_admin_up_count,
  t.total_ports,
  t.earliest_updated,
  t.total_sg_bindings,
  t.total_dns_records,
  a.avg_bound_count
FROM top10 t
CROSS JOIN avg_calc a
ORDER BY t.bound_admin_up_count DESC

  SELECT p.id, p.status, p.device_owner, p.standard_attr_id,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securitygroupportbindings s WHERE s.port_id = p.id) AS sg_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND sa.resource_type = 'ports'
),
bound AS (
  SELECT status, device_owner,
         COUNT(*) AS bound_admin_up_count,
         MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated,
         SUM(b.sg_count) AS total_sg_bindings,
         SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portdnses d WHERE d.port_id = b.id)) AS total_dns_records
  FROM base b
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = b.standard_attr_id
  WHERE b.sg_count > 0
  GROUP BY status, device_owner
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM bound ORDER BY bound_admin_up_count DESC LIMIT 10
),
totals AS (
  SELECT p.status, p.device_owner, COUNT(*) AS total_ports
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
  GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
)
